notes.title: Curve Games Publisher sale 2024
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/curvepublishersale_2024
][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/30ee8ddf9c6508d9d0668ff16c01acde47fb3e4c.png[/img][/url]

Our 2024 publisher event is here!
 
Grab your virtual hard hat and step into the bustling assembly line: this is where the magic happens, where code and pixels turn ideas into games that captivate millions of players around the world.
 
Take advantage of the best deals we ever offered, check out our new bundles and discover what games we are carefully putting together for the rest of year!

[h1]FOR THE KING II
[/h1]
We’re excited to bring forth this update as our Q1 Quality of Life update. The main focus of this update was to level up the current set of characters skill sets and kits and make certain characters a bit more fun to play. We also have a whole host of global changes - Find skills can now activate on vehicles, we’ve made some changes to how Taunt works, and the dreaded misclick on the overworld costing you focus can now be refunded! 

We’ve also made broad changes to the in-game encyclopedia, reworked tooltips to provide more pertinent information, added a few new settings, squashed a bunch of bugs and smoothed out a few areas of the game. We are once again asking the Kraken to drop more loot. 

[h1]SPACE CREW
[/h1]
Ready for an out-of-this-world adventure? From March 1st to 13th, dive into Space Crew: Legendary Edition for [b]FREE[/b] and keep it forever!

As we gear up for our upcoming release, Badlands Crew, we invite you to join us on a journey across the cosmos.

Take your chance to explore the stars! The offer ends[b] March 13th![/b]
See you among the galaxies! 🚀


[h1]WOBBLY LIFE
[/h1]
We are delighted to announce that Wobbly Life is now available on [url=https://www.nvidia.com/en-gb/geforce-now/how-to-play/]GeForce Now[/url]!

[b]What GeForce Now is:[
[/b]
GeForce Now allows you to play your games seamlessly on all your devices; transforming your laptop, desktop, Mac, TV, phone into the most powerful method of gaming!

[b]What else is going on?
[/b]
We’re continuing to work hard on our next update which is [b]coming soon[/b]! 
The next update will contain translation of the game in new languages, new costumes from the latest community contest and many more surprises on... and underneath… Wobbly Island.
We can’t wait to share more about our next update and we hope you will love it as much as we do! 🐸

notes.title: Rake in some awesome games during the Steam Autumn Sale
notes.content:
Ah, Autumn…

Not too warm nor too cold, with its charming colours, relaxing sights, and nature-defying coffee flavours.

Picture this: you are at your PC, enjoying a nice cup of tea and looking through the window. 
Suddenly, you see a red leaf fall from a nearby tree: reminded about the fleeting nature of life, you decide to have some fun and play a new video game.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/curvedigital/sale/Autumnsale2021][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/979620b7202d037e939b9c98872ad7549ad6e2aa.png[/img][/url]

A bit of a stretch? Maybe, but, to celebrate the season, Curve Games is now offering discounts on ALMOST (looking at you, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1685910/Lawn_Mowing_Simulator__Ancient_Britain/]Ancient Britain DLC[/url]) its entire catalog.
What are you waiting for? Check them out on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/curvedigital/sale/Autumnsale2021]Autumn Sale page[/url], and rake in a bunch of games at unbeleafable prices!

[i]No, I’m not sorry about these puns.[/i]


[h1]Steam Awards[/h1]

The Steam Awards are back, and throughout the Autumn Sale you'll be able to vote for your favourite games in the 10 categories selected by Valve.

We know it's going to be a hard decision to make, but we would like to humbly suggest some of our games for a few of the available categories.

[list]
[*] The Ascent – [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/979690/view/3149700446296381928]"Outstanding Visual Style" Award[/url]
[*] Lawn Mowing Simulator – [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1480560/view/3105790349933969482]"Sit back and Relax" Award[/url]
[*] I Am Fish – [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1472560/view/3096781247201934409]"Best Game You Suck At" Award[/url]
[*] For The King –[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/527230/view/3131686047795370611]"Labor of Love" Award[/url]
[*] Human: Fall Flat – [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/477160/view/3130560147884275312]"Labor of Love" Award[/url]
[*] Autonauts – [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/979120/view/3104665083324224893]"Labor of Love" Award[/url]
[*] Embr – [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1062830/view/3150826346207555249]"Better With Friends" Award[/url]
[*] Just Die Already – [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/979070/announcements/detail/3113671649292421055]"Better With Friends" Award[/url]
[/list]
Please consider voting for us if you believe that our games embrace the essence of those categories!


[h2]Lawn Mowing Simulator: New DLC and major update[/h2]

Lawn Mowing Simulator just received its [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1480560/view/4492898490996138736]biggest update yet[/url] with the addition of string trimmers, giving mowing aficionados everywhere an entirely new way to approach the ever growing menace of tall grass in their lawns.
At the same time, the first paid DLC for the game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1685910/Lawn_Mowing_Simulator__Ancient_Britain/]Ancient Britain[/url], has been released, containing 4 brand-new challenging locations set in iconic British sites.


[h2]Human: Fall Flat - Lumber[/h2]

Talking about "Labors of Love", earlier this month [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/477160/view/3090026481854611419]we released a 19th level[/url] for our Human: Fall Flat community.
Born from the ingenious mind of David Nielsen, one of our community creators, Lumber will challenge you with a mix of old and new elements.
So limber up, gather some friends, grab an axe and start exploring this amazing new level!


[h2]Space Crew: Thanksgiving Edition[/h2]
Did someone say Thanksgiving?
Enjoy a delectable festive banquet on the Athena station, courtesy of Wing Commander Lyra...just make sure to keep it away from the turkey that will be roaming the deck!
And remember: in space no-one can hear you cluck...

notes.title: Win exclusive prizes with Hotshot Team Rivals
notes.content:
Brand new free Hotshot Racing DLC ‘Big Boss Bundle’ is out now on PC and consoles, featuring colourful new tracks, a new Grand Prix Championship – and brand new game mode, Barrel Barrage!
 
[previewyoutube=wethUHcYFMY;full][/previewyoutube]
Barrel Barrage takes Hotshot Racing’s trademark breakneck speed and add explosive barrels to the mix. Launched from the rear of each vehicle, barrels explode on contact with competitor’s cars, inflicting damage and making each dash for the chequered flag more perilous.
 
To celebrate this explosive new mode, we’re starting Hotshot Team Rivals, a competition that pits Hotshot against Hotshot for the chance to win their own incredible 3D printed car model and trophy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36924418/b2479d99a25f3aaefb3f433bc29825ff6b70baf6.gif[/img]
 
Think you’ve got what it takes? Just follow these simple steps:

[h3]Capture your Barrel Barrage moments[/h3]
Barrel Barrage isn’t short of hectic battles and we want to see the best moments you can muster. Grab a short clip of your most spectacular race via each platform’s recording feature.
 
[h3]Pick a team[/h3]
It’s a rivalry as old as time: Red vs. Blue! But choose your team wisely; once you pick, there’s no going back
 
[h3]Share your clips[/h3]
Join your chosen team by tweeting your clip with either the hashtag #HotshotReds or #HotshotBlues
 
And that’s it! We’ll choose the best clips from each team very soon, and ask the Hotshot community to vote for their favourites. Three racers from our winning team will then receive their awesome Hotshots prizes.

[b]Looking for a race? Jump into our [url=https://discord.gg/curvedigital]Discord[/url] and join a game with our Hotshot community!
[/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36924418/7e8c357a74df538065a2068341cc0eb85b923f6f.jpg[/img]
 
But before your begin, take a quick look at our list of rules:
[list]
[*] Barrel Barrage mode must be used in all clips
[*] All clips must be recorded in an online game (feel free to use either Ranked or Public games)
[*] Share as many clips as you like, but only for one team – the first hashtag you use will be counted as your official choice
[*] Entries are limited to players in Europe and North America due to shipping restrictions
[/list]
[b]Have a Hotshot stream planned soon? You can also enter our competition with this! Just share the link to your stream with us on Twitter and use the relevant hashtag[/b]
 
We can’t wait to check out your awesome Barrel Barrage clips. In the meantime, let us know what you think of the Big Boss Bundle on [b][url=https://discord.gg/curvedigital]Discord[/url][/b] and [url=https://twitter.com/curvedigital][b]Twitter[/b][/url]!

[list]
[*] [b]Barrel Barrage Mode[/b]
Take Hotshot Racing’s trademark breakneck speed and add explosive barrels to the mix. Launched from the rear of each vehicle, barrels explode on contact with competitors’ cars, inflicting damage and making each dash for the chequered flag more perilous. 

[*] [b]Boss Level Grand Prix [/b]
Expand the roster of championships in Hotshot Racing with the Boss Level Grand Prix including four new high-speed circuits - 8 Ball Highway, Cargo Chaos, Frozen Freeway and Surf City - each with visually arresting vistas to zip past. All game modes, including Barrel Barrage, are available across all tracks introduced in the Boss Level Grand Prix  
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36924418/5e348a411065b4c49b627d29d919e3dd6044478d.gif[/img]

Since launch, we've also addressed fan feedback and kept the game up-to-date with regular patches across all platforms. This includes increased car speed across Normal, Hard and Expert modes, improved multiplayer lobby functionality, controller detection fixes for the PC version of the game and more.

But we're still listening to all your feedback. Please feel free to share more info with us below or in the [url=https://discord.gg/curvedigital][b]Curve Digital Discord[/b][/url].

[b]Don't forget to let us know what you think of Big Boss Bundle![/b]

notes.title: Hotshot Racing Update Now Live
notes.content:
Since Hotshot Racing's launch back in September, we've been blown away by the love and support our retro racer has received. It's been incredible to see all the lightning-fast laps, photo finishes and explosive scrapes from all our hard-drivin' Hotshots.
 
We're pleased to reveal Hotshot Racing has been installed more than [b]500K times[/b] across all platforms! Check out some other interesting Hotshot tidbits below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36924418/3e8e6349dc4f9679452587b30448339819c31018.gif[/img]

We've also been listening closely to all of your feedback and are pleased to announce our first [b]Hotshot Racing update[/b], which tackles many of the common issues you've been sharing on Twitter, Discord and Steam.
[list]
[*] [b]Achievement unlocks[/b]: Players can now unlock the 'Overachiever'  and 'Trophy Hunter' achievements

[*] [b]Quick/Ranked Race fixes[/b]: Resolved the issue where players were unable to start a race

[*] [b]Speed glitch resolved[/b]: We have increased car speed across Normal, Hard and Expert modes! Jump into Time Trial and set new records with upgraded performance

[/list]
And we're still listening! Feel free to share you feedback on these updates, or any other issues you're having:
[list]
[*] In our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/609920/discussions/]Steam forums[/url]
[*] On our [url=discord.gg/curvedigital]Discord server[/url]
[*] By commenting below!
[/list]
We hope these updates give you an even better Hotshot experience. Have these fixes improved the game for you? If so, [b]please leave a review or rating[/b] on Steam, Xbox or PlayStation Store.

notes.title: Arcade Driving Perfection: Hotshot Racing is out now!
notes.content:
[h3]Hotshot Racing takes the colourful and iconic arcade racing formula of the 90s and updates it for the modern generation. We're delighted to say it's out right now on Steam![/h3]

[previewyoutube=3glVhkFAcvc;full][/previewyoutube]
Featuring tracks in playfully reimagined locations from across the globe, drivers bursting with personality and an easy to pick up yet hard to master drift-centric gameplay, Hotshot Racing is perfect for anyone who spent their formative years slinging coins into driving games at arcades.

Hotshot Racing’s is available for [b]£15.99 / €19.99 / $19.99[/b] but during the week of launch, prospective racers can purchase the game for [b]20% off that price[/b]. Additionally there are no microtransactions, and we're already working on free post-release downloadable content in the guise of new tracks, a new championship and more! Further details on this new content will be shared in the weeks ahead. Here's a little tease!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36924418/00874e316e87ff139e9302dcaa07eb0c9598a2ca.gif[/img]

Here's a full rundown of everything you can expect from Hotshot Racing:
[list]
[b][*] RACE AROUND THE WORLD[/b]
Hotshot Racing features 16 tracks set across the globe with sharp corners providing technical yet enjoyable challenges. Take in coastal, jungle, alpine and Las Vegas desert environments, with each course modelled with the most vivid colours and blue skies for miles.#

[b][*] PLAY YOUR WAY[/b]
Time Trial and Grand Prix modes cater to those who like to compete in classic racing formats, while ‘Cops and Robbers’ and ‘Drive or Explode’ modes offer exhilarating new ways to play. Smash lap records to rise-up the global online leaderboards or download ghost laps to match your racing lines against the very best.

[b][*] MEET THE HOTSHOTS[/b]
Keiko, Xing, Mike, Alexa, Aston, Toshiro, Marcus and Viktor - eight speed addicts that have dedicated their lives to the pursuit of being the greatest racing driver in the world. Each racer has four unique vehicles which pay homage to some of the most iconic racing cars on the planet.

[b][*] ADDITIONAL RACE TYPES[/b]
In addition to classic single race and championship game modes, Hotshot Racing also features two new signature game modes; Drive or Explode and Cops And Robbers. In Drive or Explode players must keep their vehicle above a minimum speed which continues to increase at regular intervals. Cops And Robbers is an eight-player game mode which casts players as law enforcement or criminals.

[b][*] GOTTA UNLOCK ‘EM ALL[/b]
Every race completed earns players dollars based on their performance which they can utilise to customise their ride from new chassis components to cockpit ‘improvements’ like furry dice and bobbleheads.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36924418/3bb13628568f866fc6021315443244034d58e58d.gif[/img]

[b]Pick up Hotshot Racing today with a 20% launch discount. We can't wait to hear what you think, and stay tuned for more updates soon!
[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/609920/Hotshot_Racing/
